description: This PHP script handles setting IP configuration parameters, including IPv4 and IPv6 settings, with validation functions for IP addresses, subnet masks, and DHCP lease times. It updates device configuration settings based on POST data.

methods.name: isValidIP
methods.description: Validates if an IP address falls within a specified IP range.

methods.name: ipRange
methods.description: Calculates the start and end IP addresses of a subnet based on gateway address and subnet mask.

methods.name: valid_GW_IP
methods.description: Checks if the gateway IP is within the valid range for the network.

methods.name: isValidGW
methods.description: Validates the gateway IP address against subnet and IP range rules for private networks.
